name: Speak
overview: Scripture emphasizes the profound impact of our words, highlighting that the tongue holds the power of life and death and that what we speak can either bring healing or cause harm. Believers are called to be quick to listen and slow to speak, ensuring their communication is wholesome, edifying, and gracious to others. This discipline involves careful timing and thoughtful speech, avoiding corrupt or harmful words, so that the words we utter build up rather than break down.
